final: WITH budget_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM budget_totals), above_average AS (SELECT bt.total_cost, bt.expense_count, oa.avg_total FROM budget_totals bt CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE bt.total_cost > oa.avg_total) SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_total, SUM(expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(total_cost - avg_total) AS average_excess FROM above_average
